peak_reset.value: No CUDA peak counter is reset on CPU. Local pr/pa are initialized to current reserved/allocated at start of each replay invocation (including k=3 measure_0); one Replayer/cache is retained across load and all four runs. GPU takes start then reset_peak_memory_stats before each actual measure.

value.h: Floating storage following model dtype; size (s+1)//2, including inferred_h.
value.f: Explicit fixed FP32 float storage remains full size, including inferred_f.
value.b: Synthetic uint8 cast buffer already sized for FP16-run copy; unchanged.
value.cast_lifetime: No-op FP32 casts that would be real FP16 casts are represented by uint8 buffers attached to aliases; downcast sources receive early free and later original free is suppressed.
value.matching: Address+size with monotone call cursor. Unmatched allocations inherit next matched h/f/x or inferred_h; this is inference, not proof of exact GPU dtype.
value.T5: T5LayerNorm downcast branch forced; T5Block half branch tested via shadow tag. Patch report per executed case.
value.resident_and_load: FP16-structured model supplies synthetic checkpoint-order allocation/cast events; FP32 execution model residency is not inserted as FP32 into xMem.
value.finite: FP32 run cannot establish FP16 output finiteness.

value.text: randint int64 [3,vocab); pad/eos/bos/decoder_start IDs replaced by 3; all-ones int64 mask; no tokenizer.
value.vision: randn FP32 -> FP16 host image; hash FP16 bytes; FP32 execution uses cast of same rounded image.
value.generation: GenerationConfig.from_model_config, greedy, num_beams=1, use_cache=True, min_new_tokens=max_new_tokens=N, hub generation config replaced.
value.token_count: Decoder output length minus L; T5 output length minus 1 decoder_start. Mismatch raises generation_length_mismatch.
value.lifetime: Per invoke clone input inside profiled region; M4 with gi/o alive; del gi,o then M5.

value.limitation: GPU pilot CSV stores 16-hex prefixes; no claim of full SHA256 equality. Pending/main cases have no GPU full result for comparison.

claims_in_code.value: Worker docstring claims 36/36 (26 FP32 +10 v1 FP16); helper check_replicated_replay.py compares prediction bytes after replay. No persisted helper stdout artifact was found in targeted docs/results/log files. Current stored native pilot set has 11 successful results, so audit below records actual available scope.
